medicationReminders.title: Medication reminders
medicationReminders.metaDescription: Save reminders for your medicines with a dose and times, and see today's doses and refill dates in your Nabd Plus account.
medicationReminders.answer: Medication reminders on Nabd Plus keep the medicines you take, each with its dose, frequency and times. Sign in, open Medications and choose Add reminder. The Today tab then shows which doses are taken, still to take, skipped or missed.
medicationReminders.p1Body: Add, edit or delete a reminder with the medicine name, the dose, the frequency (daily, weekly or as needed) and one or more times.
medicationReminders.p2Body: See each dose of the day and whether it was taken, skipped or missed.
medicationReminders.p3Body: See the refill dates of your medicines and the chronic medicines recorded in your profile.
medicationReminders.q1: Will I get a notification when a dose is due?
medicationReminders.a1: Yes, in the Nabd Plus mobile app: it schedules a notification on your phone at each saved time, and you can mark the dose as taken from it. The website shows your reminders and doses but does not send these notifications.
medicationReminders.q2: Does Nabd Plus tell me which medicine or dose to take?
medicationReminders.a2: No. You enter the medicine and the dose yourself. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before changing how you take a medicine.
medicationReminders.q3: Where do I find my reminders?
medicationReminders.a3: After you sign in, open Medications. Its tabs show today's doses, all reminders, refills and chronic medicines.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy tracking
pregnancy.metaTitle: Pregnancy week tracker and cycle estimate
pregnancy.metaDescription: Follow your pregnancy week by week, see your logged baby kicks and contractions, record baby growth and see a cycle estimate on Nabd Plus.
pregnancy.answer: Pregnancy tracking on Nabd Plus, in the Maternity section, shows your pregnancy week, trimester and due date from the details you enter. Sign in, open Maternity and set up your profile for pregnancy or cycle tracking to start.
pregnancy.p1Body: Your week of pregnancy, the trimester and the due date, with the baby kicks and contractions you logged.
pregnancy.p2Body: Your baby's weight, height and head size, entry by entry, month by month.
pregnancy.p3Body: An estimated ovulation day, fertile window and next period, calculated from your last period and cycle length.
pregnancy.a1: No. The dates and weeks shown are estimates based on your entries and do not replace your doctor.
pregnancy.q2: Can I use the cycle estimate as contraception?
pregnancy.a2: No. The estimate is calculated from your last period and your cycle length. It is for awareness only and is not contraception.
pregnancy.q3: Can I book an obstetrician or a scan?
pregnancy.a3: Yes. From Maternity you can book an obstetrics consultation with a specialist, or book an ultrasound or another scan near you.

mentalHealth.title: Mental health and wellbeing
mentalHealth.metaDescription: Keep a mood journal and book a psychiatry consultation in your Nabd Plus account.
mentalHealth.answer: Mental health on Nabd Plus brings together a mood journal and booking with psychiatry doctors. Sign in and open Mental health to see a summary of what you recorded yourself; it is not a diagnosis.
mentalHealth.p1Body: Record your mood, energy and stress, and see your entries from the last 30 days.
mentalHealth.p2Body: Find psychiatry doctors in consultations and book a visit.
mentalHealth.q1: Does Nabd Plus diagnose or score my mental health?
mentalHealth.a1: No. The figures describe only what you recorded. They are not a diagnosis, a risk score or a treatment recommendation.
mentalHealth.q2: What should I do if I need urgent help?
mentalHealth.a2: Nabd Plus is not an emergency service. If you need help right away, open Urgent help in your account: it calls the urgent-help number set up for Nabd Plus. If you are in danger, contact your local emergency services.
mentalHealth.q3: How do I book a therapist?
mentalHealth.a3: Open Mental health and choose Book a therapist. It lists psychiatry doctors in consultations, where you choose a doctor and a time.

nutrition.title: Nutrition tracking
nutrition.metaTitle: Meal log, calories and water tracking
nutrition.metaDescription: Log your meals, follow today's calories and water against your own daily targets and set your nutrition goal in your Nabd Plus account.
nutrition.answer: Nutrition on Nabd Plus lets you log your meals and see today's calories and water against daily targets you set yourself. Sign in, open Nutrition, set your goal and targets in the Target tab, then use Log a meal for each meal.
nutrition.p1Body: Today's calories against your target, your water, and the meals you logged today.
nutrition.p2Body: Save a meal with its type (breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack), its name and its calories.
nutrition.p3Body: Set your goal, activity level, height, weight, daily calories and water, and any dietary restrictions or allergies.
nutrition.q1: Where do the calorie figures come from?
nutrition.a1: From the calories you enter for each meal. Your daily summary adds them up and compares them with the daily target you set.
nutrition.q2: Can I record allergies and dietary restrictions?
nutrition.a2: Yes. Add them in the Target tab, together with your goal and your daily targets.
nutrition.a3: No. Nutrition shows what you recorded. Ask your doctor before changing your diet.

family.title: Family health
family.metaTitle: Family group, shared health files and calendar
family.metaDescription: Create a family group on Nabd Plus, choose what each member can see, follow a shared calendar of appointments and chat with your family.
family.answer: Family on Nabd Plus lets you create a family group, invite relatives or join a group with a code, and choose what each member can see. Sign in and open Family to add a member, answer requests, see the family calendar and use the family chat.
family.p1Body: Each member has a health file. You choose whether a member can view vitals, medications, reports and appointments.
family.p2Body: Everyone's appointments and medicines in one calendar.
family.q1: Who can see my health information?
family.a1: Only the members you allow. For each member you choose whether they can view your vitals, medications, reports and appointments, and you approve or reject their requests.
family.q2: How does a relative join my family group?
family.a2: Use Add member in Family to invite them, or they can choose Join with a code.
family.q3: Where do I add emergency contacts?
family.a3: In Family, open Emergency contacts. They are kept in your health profile.

loyalty.title: Nabd points
loyalty.metaTitle: Nabd points: rewards, challenges and referrals
loyalty.metaDescription: Earn Nabd points, redeem them for rewards, join health challenges and invite friends with your referral code in your Nabd Plus account.
loyalty.answer: Nabd points is the Nabd Plus loyalty program. Sign in and open Nabd points to see your balance and tier, redeem points for rewards, join health challenges and share your referral code.
loyalty.p1Body: Redeem your points for the rewards on offer. Some rewards give you a coupon code.
loyalty.p2Body: Join health challenges and earn points when you complete them.
loyalty.p3Body: Share your referral code. When your friend signs up and completes a first booking, points are added for both of you.
loyalty.a1: Your account lists the ways to earn points. You also earn points from health challenges and when a friend you invited completes a first booking.
loyalty.q2: Who can apply a referral code?
loyalty.a2: A new account, before its first completed booking.
loyalty.a3: No. Medicines that need a prescription are not included in any offers, discounts or loyalty points.

onlineConsultations.title: Online video consultations
onlineConsultations.metaDescription: Book a video consultation with a doctor on Nabd Plus, join the call from your appointment and message the doctor about your booking.
onlineConsultations.answer: Online consultations on Nabd Plus are video visits with a doctor that you book in advance. Choose a doctor who offers video consultations, pick a time and pay online; at the appointment time, join the call from your appointment page.
onlineConsultations.p1Body: Filter doctors by specialty and by video consultation, then pick a time that suits you.
onlineConsultations.p2Body: Join the call from your appointment. You can turn your camera and microphone on or off.
onlineConsultations.p3Body: Message the doctor in the chat of your booking. There is no free chat outside a booking.
onlineConsultations.q1: How do I pay for an online consultation?
onlineConsultations.a1: Online consultations are paid electronically, in advance, when you book.
onlineConsultations.a2: If the doctor writes a prescription, it appears on your appointment page. Whether a prescription is needed is the doctor's decision alone.
onlineConsultations.q3: Is an online consultation for emergencies?
onlineConsultations.a3: No. Nabd Plus is not for emergencies. In an emergency, call 997.
